prompt: A first-floor window in an old brick house seen from a fixed point across the garden, with Jenny standing behind the glass in the centre of the frame, her face turned towards the camera, her brows lifted high, her eyes wide and her mouth open in a small shocked O. One of her hands is raised and gripping the cord of a cream roller blind that is half down. Net curtains hang at the edge and a shelf with a small plant sits behind her, and the light is flat grey afternoon daylight with a faint reflection of the sky across the window. Slightly soft focus, washed-out colour and mild compression. Thanks.
